Question: assalamualaikum, boolthe hein ke paidh poude sab allah ka zikr karthe hein, kyaa yeh sirf din mein zikr kar the hein , yaa phir raath mein bhi , kyoun ke boolajatha hai ke raath mein paidoun ke paas na baitha karooo. Answer ID: 9334 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1648/1355=L/1429) According to the Quran, the heaven, the earth and every thing between them glorify Allah. The trees and plants too do so. This glorification is common; there is no specification of time. The Holy Quran says about the prophet Dawood ( ع ل يه السلام ): إنا سخرنا الجبال معه يسبحن بالعشي والإشراق We had subjugated the mountains to join him (in) making tasbiH (i.e. pronouncing Allah?s purity) at evening and sunrise. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
